notes.title: Version 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
Version 1.1 has released! Please report any bugs you find on either steam boards or discord.

Also, for those that missed it, the soundtrack is also now available for purchase: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166190/Runeroots_TD_Soundtrack/

Full patch notes for v1.1.2:

Features:

- 28 new perks and 28 new upgraded perks, one for each tower!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195567/59329389ec233d3961ab70407bf86e9d721fafe4.png[/img]

- All items now have an unlockable purple quality tier which has a rare chance to appear as item rewards

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195567/3f0c4cb09a702781a567d7cd8fc2b92897eeb209.png[/img]

- Replaced one of grey item rewards at the Carnival with a purple item reward
- 72 new challenges to unlock purple tier items
- 1 new Steam achievement for finding a purple item



Quality of Life:
- Added a wave counter to the tower information panel showing how long a tower has existed
- Placing towers with a corrupt perk that alters range now correctly shows the adjusted range before placement


Other:

- Removed legacy code that let you drag items, which is no longer used
- Changed descriptions of challenges that referenced old names for towers
- Antidote item will always trigger even if the tower is immune to the negative effect
- some localization changes

Bug Fixes:

- Removed an extra sound effect that was playing when the cart launcher attacked
- The victory and defeat sound effects now correct scale with the Interface Volume option
- Fixed Promotion repeatable perk not being selectable in the adventure levels
- Selecting Powers Refresh when outside of combat levels now gives a power if you have the Expertise relic
- Closing the tower info panel will also always close the full tower details panel
- Closing the tower info panel while hovering over it now no longer blocks you from interacting with objects
- Closing the inventory panel while hovering over it now no longer blocks you from interacting with objects
- Fixed Powered Up 2 challenge sometimes incorrectly triggering instead of Powered Up
- Selecting Arcade, Slot Machine, or Piano perks after selecting Dark Conjuring now correctly converts them to their shadow versions
- Fixed an issue where the Piano wasn't always getting added to the Conjuring tower's attack pool
- Fixed Rune Power perk not being calculated for Mana attacks for the Runic Tower
- Fixed Round Shield item not correctly adding Critical Damage
- Fixed incorrect description for Slot Machine rank 3
- Fixed Talisman item calculations being too low
- Flaming Bolts corrupt perk now correctly updates the damage type of the tower in the tower information panel
- Fixed the camera sometimes not being centered on the crystal when loading combat levels
- Fixed Brawler level 8 incorrectly giving a Perk reward instead of an Upgraded Perk reward

notes.title: Version 1.1 coming later this month!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Thank you all for checking out Runeroots TD. It has been great to see a bunch of you enjoying my game over the last month since release.

I wanted to share a quick peak at what is to come later this month in the first major update! This update is all about the color purple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195567/59329389ec233d3961ab70407bf86e9d721fafe4.png[/img]

New perks!!! Each tower will be getting an additional purple perk as well as the upgraded version.


And that is not all, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195567/3f0c4cb09a702781a567d7cd8fc2b92897eeb209.png[/img]

Purple quality items!!! These will be rare finds that are even more powerful. Each item is getting a new tier with a matching challenge to unlock them. In Adventure mode, you can also find these as rewards in the carnival.

You can also expect some quality of life upgrades and plenty of bug fixes.

For those of you who have been asking for it, the soundtrack will also be available for purchase very soon!

Thanks again, and please continue to submit bugs and feedback on discord and in the Steam forums. More details soon!

notes.title: Massive Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

I just pushed a massive update to the demo to bring it closer to the current version of the game!

Here are a few of the key changes:

[b]Overhauled UI[/b] - Every aspect of the UI has had a new coat of paint. You should find the UI to be easier to read, more reactive, more informative, and hopefully prettier.

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b] - Various quality of life improvements such as:

1) being able to see your electricity per island by hovering over any part of the island
2) Left Click to equip items (no more dragging)
3) Tooltips are hidden unless you hold a a button to display them.
4) You can now see which negative conditions are active for the run at the start of each fight
5) Additional Codex pages for more information about how mechanics work

[b]NEW Collections system[/b] - Selecting a tower/perk/item for the first time will add them to your collection! View the full collection in town.


Additionally, I have been hard at work finishing up the game. I am hoping to still keep a Q2 release.

Some of the new features I have added since the demo are:

1) Upgraded perks - allowing you to find stronger versions of existing perks.
2) Corrupt perks - perks that completely change the behavior of a tower. As an example, maybe before it was a single target tower, but the perk converts it to an AOE tower at the cost of damage.
3) Additional content - I almost doubled the amount of relics, and also added some additional perks and items.

Thanks for playing, and more information about release soon!
